mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (current level minus level three months prior) compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital for firms and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the past two months.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic contractions, a decline in industrial production below 110.0 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 during late-cycle contractions.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months (current level minus level three months prior) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has declined over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment above 5.0% and a federal funds rate below 3.0% signals a recessionary environment with monetary accommodation, which is associated with negative equity returns due to reduced corporate earnings growth and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (as defined by two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a further deterioration in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines during a recession.
